title: Self-maintaining second brain: RAW, WIKI, CLAUDE.md, five automations
summary: Ryven describes a self-maintaining knowledge compiler replacing manual second brains: immutable RAW ingest, model-written WIKI, central CLAUDE.md identity file, and five automations (ingest, write, manage, review, maintain) that close a compounding context loop without manual tagging.
question_it_answers: How can an agent-maintained RAW/WIKI/CLAUDE.md stack replace a manual second brain?

claims.text: RAW holds immutable unstructured ground truth while WIKI is structured evergreen knowledge written by the model, not the user.
claims.evidence: RAW holds everything unstructured. articles. transcripts. notes. screenshots. immutable. ground truth.
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge

claims.text: Five automations — ingest, write, manage, review, maintain — run without being asked.
claims.evidence: five automations run the whole thing without you. INGEST captures and extracts. WRITE retrieves and drafts.
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops

claims.text: After three months the researcher had 4,000 notes in RAW with zero time spent organizing.
claims.evidence: three months in he has 4,000 notes in RAW. zero time spent organizing.
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge

claims.text: Quoted t.co/wBLzP25PUm resolves to X article 2090496192136290304 (carrier imryven/2090512486738845784), titled The Second Brain Is Not a Storage System. It's a Compiler. fxtwitter article payload is 44 blocks / 43 nonempty / 7,394 chars.
claims.evidence: The Second Brain Is Not a Storage System. It's a Compiler. 44 blocks / 43 nonempty / 7,394 chars on analysis/_work/captures/ryven-quote-fx.json.
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge

claims.text: Article body ships four prompts (ingest source → wiki pages; interview → vault-root CLAUDE.md; project folder Inputs/Process/Outputs/Feedback; daily compilation task), not the tweet/infographic's five automations (ingest, write, manage, review, maintain).
claims.evidence: The prompts that run the system... To ingest a new source... To build your CLAUDE.md... To build a project folder... To set up the daily compilation loop.
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops

claims.text: Article architecture is three folders plus CLAUDE.md: raw/ is an input buffer, wiki/ is compilation (one source touches ten to fifteen pages), output/ is built from compiled knowledge. Infographic ctx/mem and 4,000 RAW notes / three months are not in the article; the 3-month line is qualitative (wiki surfaces connections).
claims.evidence: raw/ is the input buffer, not the brain... wiki/ is where compilation happens. One source touches ten to fifteen pages... Three months in: the wiki surfaces connections you never consciously made.
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge

claims.text: Article-stated compile-beats-search threshold is around 50 to 100 well-compiled sources. Loop requires Claude Desktop and a paid plan; scheduled tasks and filesystem access fail on the free tier. A bad source “has touched fifteen pages before you notice.”
claims.evidence: That threshold is around 50 to 100 well-compiled sources... this requires Claude Desktop and a paid plan... A bad source in a compiler has touched fifteen pages before you notice.
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge

claims.text: Article attributes Karpathy “LLM Wiki” to April 2026 and states 5,000 stars / 16 million views on a single post. Those integers are article copy, not a first-party GitHub receipt. api.github.com/users/imryven is 404; search users q=imryven returns total_count 0 — still no public repo.
claims.evidence: He called it LLM Wiki. The idea spread across GitHub within days. 5,000 stars. 16 million views... GET https://api.github.com/users/imryven 404; search users q=imryven total_count 0.
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge

media.description: Architecture infographic titled Second Brain Architecture showing RAW to WIKI flow, CLAUDE.md center hub, five automations (ingest, write, manage, review, maintain), directory tree for raw/wiki/output/ctx/mem folders, and a sources-to-memory feedback loop.

judge_hints.why_must_read: Concrete directory and automation pattern for agent-maintained project memory.
